findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "suggest_topics" is 1758 chars, far longer than this server's median (327). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_topic_feed, search_topic_findings, search, follow_topic, create_topic, read_notes, read_team, read_profile, report_content, send_to_topic, suggest_topics, save_reaction, read_hot_takes, post_hot_take, read_news, read_topic_posts, read_topic_post, read_dashboard · Private data: edit_topic, create_topic, add_topic_attachment, read_team, send_to_topic, suggest_topics, start_scan · Public sink: create_topic, set_topic_image, send_invite, post_to_team_room, report_content, send_to_topic, suggest_topics, send_finding_feedback, save_reaction, read_hot_takes, post_hot_take, read_topic_posts, read_topic_post · Destructive: search, bookmark_finding, edit_topic, read_notes, delete_note, start_scan, delete_hot_take.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
